info.title: SLSEA Solar Generation Data API
info.description:
I7 Regional summaries, device ingestion, operational reads, reading history, hierarchy, authentication and policy. Health and documentation remain public.
Domain endpoints use /v1 and JWT bearer authentication. Every user operation
requires its documented scope; all errors use the Error schema.
Demo password: Solar#Demo2026 (all seven seeded users).
Demo logins: national.operator@slsea.lk, national.analyst@slsea.lk,
western.province@slsea.lk, central.province@slsea.lk,
colombo.district@slsea.lk, gampaha.district@slsea.lk, kandy.district@slsea.lk.

post.summary: Log in as a seeded SLSEA user
post.description: Public; requires no scope. Strict email/password body; lowercases email. Unknown email and wrong password return the same 401. Token responses use Cache-Control: no-store.

get.description: Requires a user token and account:manage scope. Password-version revocation is checked before returning public profile fields. No query parameters. Conditional ETag checks follow authentication and revocation.

Requires a user token and generation:read scope. Jurisdiction is derived from the token and filters only narrow. Unknown IDs return 404; outside jurisdiction returns 403. Unknown query parameters return 400. Returns a filtered, paginated collection; count and page rows share a repeatable-read transaction. District users see only their district beneath their parent province. Empty collections use total_pages=0 with first/last page=1; a beyond-last page links prev to the last real page. Reporting/include options and reading resources arrive in later increments.

District users see only their district beneath their parent province. Empty collections use total_pages=0 with first/last page=1; a beyond-last page links prev to the last real page. Each supplied filter ID is independently authorized; filters are ANDed and contradictory authorized filters return an empty set. reporting=true|false is applied before counts and pagination; include=last_known_reading fetches only page meters in one query. The list remains jurisdiction scoped. Nested readings omit site_id/meter_id and use null for no readings.

Requires user token and generation:read. Unknown query fields are rejected. Parent and each filter are resolved/authorized first; filters only narrow. UTC output; from inclusive and to exclusive. Site history from/to are optional with no default window. Sort defaults to newest first. Last-Modified is newest timestamp on the selected page and is omitted for empty pages. Encode + as %2B in query offsets; example: ?from=2026-10-09T00:00:00%2B05:30.

post.summary: Ingest a reading for the authenticated device
post.description: Requires a device token with readings:write scope. User tokens are forbidden. Path site must match the claim, and stored meter must match the token. Unknown queries and body fields, including site_id/meter_id, are rejected. Counter must be at least the nearest earlier counter. Concurrent writes per installation serialize this check. Duplicate meter/timestamp returns 409. Conditional GET headers do not suppress a successful create.

201.description: Created reading; canonical UTC timestamp in absolute Location

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: URL-encoded ISO timestamp with Z or timezone offset; canonical responses use UTC.

get.description: Requires user token and generation:read. Unknown query fields are rejected. Parent and each filter are resolved/authorized first; filters only narrow. UTC output; from inclusive and to exclusive. Default to=now, from=to-24h; maximum span 31 days. Filters are ANDed. Sort defaults to newest first. Last-Modified is newest timestamp on the selected page and is omitted for empty pages. Encode + as %2B in query offsets; example: ?from=2026-10-09T00:00:00%2B05:30.

Requires a user token and generation:read scope. Unknown query parameters are rejected. Authorization precedes any conditional result. Newest measurement ordered by timestamp descending. Empty installation returns 404. age_seconds is nonnegative whole seconds; is_stale uses the exact inclusive freshness threshold (default 30 minutes). Last-Modified is the reading timestamp.

get.summary: Read installation hierarchy and today totals
get.description: Requires a user token and generation:read scope. Unknown query parameters are rejected. Authorization precedes any conditional result. Bare installation fields with parent id/name objects, compact nullable latest reading and Asia/Colombo today totals. Today uses latest today minus previous-day baseline, falling back to first reading today. Empty today returns zeros; negative counter deltas clamp to zero. No Last-Modified on this composite.

Requires a user token with generation:read. Root resolves from the verified caller: national, own province, or own district. Regional forms require jurisdiction authorization; parent-province metadata navigation does not authorize province aggregates. Unknown queries are rejected. One parameterized SQL snapshot: latest readings within the preceding 48 hours and not after as_of; reporting uses STALE_AFTER_MINUTES (inclusive). Power uses reporting latest readings. Today energy uses latest today minus last counter before Asia/Colombo midnight, falling back to first today, with negative differences clamped to zero. Baselines have no age cutoff. Zero-installation regions return zeros. Last-Modified is as_of; authentication/authorization precede conditional evaluation.

RequestId.description: Server-generated UUID shared by the response and logs

ETag.description: Strong SHA-256 hash of the serialized representation. If-Match uses strong comparison; If-None-Match uses weak comparison after authentication and authorization.

Vary.description: GET responses vary by Accept and Authorization, and Origin for CORS

Location.description: Absolute URI of a newly created resource (introduced in I6)

LastModified.description: Source timestamp: reading time for reading resources, as_of for generation summaries. Omitted on empty reading pages and metadata/overview/list resources.

Link.description: RFC 8288 first/prev/next/last links; null relations are omitted.

CacheControl.description: Authenticated GETs require revalidation; token responses forbid caching.

error.message: The requested resource was not found.

timestamp.description: Z or offset; UTC storage. At most 5 minutes ahead, at most 30 days old.

cumulative_energy_Kwh.description: Must not be below the nearest earlier reading.

Page.name: page
Page.description: Positive integer page. Out-of-range pages return empty data with correct totals; database offset must fit a signed 32-bit integer.

PageSize.name: page_size
PageSize.description: Positive integer page size; defaults and maximum come from runtime configuration (50 and 500).

Sort.name: sort
Sort.description: Sort by name ascending/descending; defaults to primary key ascending. Primary key breaks name ties.

From.name: from
From.description: Inclusive ISO-8601 timestamp with Z or a timezone offset; offsets with + must encode it as %2B in the URL.

To.name: to
To.description: Exclusive ISO-8601 timestamp with Z or a timezone offset; offsets with + must encode it as %2B in the URL.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Strong comparison; mismatching tags return 412 after access checks. Supports an entity-tag list or *.

IfNoneMatch.name: If-None-Match
IfNoneMatch.description: Weak comparison; a matching tag returns an empty 304 after access checks. Evaluated after If-Match.

ReadingSort.name: sort
ReadingSort.description: Chronological ordering with meter_id ascending to break timestamp ties.

IfModifiedSince.name: If-Modified-Since
IfModifiedSince.description: HTTP date. Honored only when Last-Modified exists and If-None-Match is absent. All access checks and If-Match run first.

Reporting.name: reporting
Reporting.description: Filter before count/pagination: true for latest measurement no older than STALE_AFTER_MINUTES (default 30), false for stale or never reported. Strictly true/false.

Include.name: include
Include.description: Attach the latest reading for each paged installation in one query, without duplicate IDs; null when absent.

BadRequest.description: Malformed JSON, invalid input, or body larger than 10 kb (400 VALIDATION_FAILED for size; contract has no 413)

Unauthorized.description: Missing, invalid, expired, or revoked bearer token

Forbidden.description: Principal lacks the required scope or jurisdiction

MethodNotAllowed.description: Method is unsupported on a known URI

NotAcceptable.description: Accept does not permit the offered representation (JSON, or HTML for /docs)

PreconditionFailed.description: The GET If-Match condition fails after authentication and authorization (strong comparison).

UnsupportedMediaType.description: A write requires application/json, or the JSON charset or encoding is unsupported

InternalError.description: Unhandled server fault; generic message without implementation details

NotModified.description: Current representation; empty response body. Access checks run before ETag comparison.

DuplicateReading.description: Duplicate meter/timestamp; no additional row inserted
